description: This file defines the GraphicsStateStack class, which manages a stack of graphics states (XGraphicsState and XGraphicsContainer objects) in the PDFsharp library, used for handling graphic contexts during PDF rendering or editing.

classes.name: GraphicsStateStack
classes.description: Manages a stack of graphics state objects, allowing push and restore operations during graphics state management.

methods.name: GraphicsStateStack (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the GraphicsStateStack with the provided XGraphics object.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes a graphics state onto the stack and marks it as pushed.

methods.name: Restore
methods.description: Restores the graphics state to a previously saved state, popping states off the stack until the specified state is restored.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Gets the current graphics state, either the top of the stack or the initial state if the stack is empty.
